chirality_split_principle: H^4(zeta^+) produces curvature response purely in R^- (End Omega^-); the SD block R^+ is unchanged at leading r^{-6} order. Symmetric for zeta^-.
same_chirality_zero_check_meaning: A commutator [A,R^+] with R^+=diag(Lambda,0,0) has zero (2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(3,3) block, so a Kahler-tangent same-chirality response cannot produce a first-obstruction on ker R^+. Same-chirality does not obstruct.

mixed_chirality_structure.source_reversed_receiver_compatible: H^4(zeta_i^-) response shifts R^+ (Ozuch (9) symmetric statement); at a compatible receiver (ker in R^+) this generically has a nonzero 2x2 kernel-block component M_{ji}, not a commutator, hence a genuine order t_j t_i^2 first-obstruction shift.
mixed_chirality_structure.same_chirality: H^4(zeta_i^+) response shifts R^- (chirality split); at a compatible receiver (ker in R^+) the relevant block is unchanged at leading multipole order, matching the Kahler-tangent commutator zero-check.
mixed_chirality_structure.order: receiver first-obstruction shift enters at t_j * t_i^2 (order t^3 at equal scales)
mixed_chirality_structure.object: M_{ji}^{eps_j}[phi_i] = Pi_ker R^{eps_j} dR^{eps_j}(H_{ij,2}[phi_i^{eps_i}]) Pi_ker R^{eps_j}

pattern_algebra_interpretation.r0_r4_controls: No mixed pairs. Obstruction system vacuous at this order; KE del Pezzo (and its mirror) exist. This is the calibration that forces all pattern-blind local terms to vanish.
pattern_algebra_interpretation.r1_r3: Each compatible receiver sees a single reversed source. Because r=1 has one reversed node, its three compatible receivers see it via a MIX of one diagonal-type and two adjacent-type couplings (see per_receiver_geometry). Solvability with no tunable in-kernel freedom requires the relevant kernel-block map to have a kernel. If M_adj or M_diag is invertible on ker R, r=1 (=r=3) has NO Einstein desingularization of this degeneration at this order.
pattern_algebra_interpretation.r2_diagonal_spin: The reversed pair is antipodal in both factors. Each compatible receiver is adjacent to one reversed node and diagonal to the other, so it sees one M_adj term and one M_diag term. Two tunable scale/phase ratios can attempt to cancel.
pattern_algebra_interpretation.r2_adjacent_nonspin: The reversed pair shares a pole. Each compatible receiver sees a mix of adjacent and diagonal couplings from the two reversed sources.
pattern_algebra_interpretation.deliverable: Two symmetric 2x2 kernel-block tensors M_diag and M_adj (as functions of the in-kernel source angle phi_i and receiver angle) determine ALL three pattern classes. Compute M_diag first (regular in both factors, larger stabilizer); it may already decide r=1/r=3.

summary.chirality_enters_at: inter-node mixed-chirality kernel block, order t_j t_i^2
summary.next_target: evaluate M_diag and M_adj via projected product-P Green response
summary.scope: This fixes the faithful obstruction object and proves the two zero-checks; it does NOT prove/refute P4+ or Yau-26. A vanishing M supports the local nearby-orbifold route; a nonzero invertible M excludes that route for a row but leaves global Einstein existence open.
